_comment: Canonical seed registry for the LLM Negotiation paper. Per-game seed = base + game_index. Dirichlet alpha is fixed at 1.0 for all weight sampling. Under randomized opener, the per-game seed selects the opener role uniformly.

A_no_om.description: Unassisted LLM-LLM negotiation. No opponent model.

B_unilateral.description: Buyer side has computed-target opponent model, seller does not.

C_bilateral.description: Both buyer and seller use computed-target opponent models.

opener_protocols.seller_first: Seller opens every game (original protocol; contains anchoring confound).
opener_protocols.randomized: Per-game uniform random selection of opener role using game seed.

weight_sampling: Dirichlet(alpha=1.0) over the 5-simplex; sampled fresh per game from per-game seed.

models_under_test.deepseek/deepseek-r1-0528: Tier 2 collapse-only (resists exogenous directives via endogenous CoT)

decoding_parameters.structured_output: Prompt-enforced JSON only (no provider JSON-mode used)
